description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Added per-version renderer overrides: a new renderer entry at the bottom-left of the version list lets you assign a renderer to each version individually (defaulting to following the global setting), so switching between versions no longer requires changing renderer settings back and forth; when the renderer is changed elsewhere while an override exists, a dialog offers to update, clear or keep the override (#1975)
2. Added a "launch progress overlay" toggle under the DEBUG category of the in-game right menu: when off, the overlay background and progress spinner are no longer shown at launch and the game screen appears directly from the first frame; also fixed the first-frame misdetection in the log window's auto-show logic (#2005)
3. Fixed being unable to cancel while waiting for authorization during Microsoft account re-login, and the dialog getting stuck after leaving the login page; retrying after a failed login now works (#2013)
4. Fixed Controlify requiring a controller reconnection before direct input worked: SDL gamepad device enumeration is now synced proactively at launch, with USB/Bluetooth hotplug monitoring taken over (synced from ZalithLauncher2)
5. Fixed Minecraft snapshots 13w16a~13w23b failing to launch (#2002)
6. Fixed runtime installation failures being impossible to diagnose: the full stack trace is now logged and shown in a dialog (#2011)
7. Removed the shadow in-game control buttons cast onto the screen; elevation now only keeps the buttons' stacking order (#2008)
8. Fixed main-screen version card icons being squashed when non-square: they are now scaled proportionally
9. Fixed HMCL/MultiMC modpacks failing to launch
10. Optimized task-list refreshing: task rows are now added/removed in batches, fixing list jank during high-speed downloads (#2010)
11. Optimized launch speed: unpacking built-in jars now skips files already released by comparing checksums, and an artificial delay for small files during runtime extraction was removed

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增每版本渲染器覆盖：版本列表页左下角新增渲染器入口，可为每个版本单独指定渲染器（默认跟随全局设置），多版本切换无需反复修改渲染器；存在覆盖时从其他位置修改渲染器会弹窗提示，可选更新覆盖、清除覆盖或保留覆盖 (#1975)
2.游戏内右侧菜单 DEBUG 分类新增「启动进度遮罩」开关：关闭后启动时不再显示遮罩背景与进度圈，游戏画面自首帧直接显示；并修复日志窗自动显示的首帧误判 (#2005)
3.修复微软账户重新登录等待授权期间无法取消，退出登录页面后对话框卡死的问题；登录失败后可直接重试 (#2013)
4.修复 Controlify 需重连手柄才能直通：启动时主动同步 SDL 手柄设备枚举并接管 USB/蓝牙插拔监听（同步 ZalithLauncher2）
5.修复无法启动 Minecraft 13w16a~13w23b 快照的问题 (#2002)
6.修复运行环境安装失败时无法定位原因的问题：现会记录日志并在弹窗展示完整调用栈 (#2011)
7.修复游戏内按键向画面投影阴影的问题，elevation 仅保留按键堆叠层级 (#2008)
8.修复主界面版本卡片长方形图标被压扁的问题，现按原始比例等比缩放
9.修复 HMCL/MultiMC 整合包启动崩溃的问题
10.优化任务列表刷新：任务行增删改为批量刷新，修复高速下载时列表卡顿 (#2010)
11.优化启动速度：解包内置 jar 前按校验值比对跳过重复释放，并移除运行环境解压时对小文件的人为延时
